name: sick_leave_recorded_after_the_fact
use_case: Check leave balance and submit a leave request with manager approval routing
branch: An employee asks to retroactively record 3 days of sick leave taken earlier in the week; the desk confirms details, submits sick leave request, and cites policy requirement for medical certificate for >2 consecutive days without asking for diagnosis.
tests: Confirms details, submits retroactive sick leave request for E456 (2026-10-21 to 2026-10-23), explains certificate requirement, and preserves medical privacy.
instruction:
You were ill and out of office from Wednesday 21 October to Friday 23 October 2026 (2026-10-21 to 2026-10-23). You contact the HR leave desk to record these 3 working days as sick leave.

Your details:
- Employee ID: E456
- Name: Kenji Takahashi
- Leave Type: Sick leave
- Start Date: 2026-10-21
- End Date: 2026-10-23
- Region: APAC

persona.name: Kenji Takahashi
persona.initial_message: Hi, I was out sick last week from Wednesday 21 to Friday 23 October 2026. Could you please record those 3 days of sick leave for me? My employee ID is E456.
